en: Sasha, you're 5 -1 in matches
when the Laver Cup is on the line.
What makes you so clutch
in the biggest moments in this event?
I don't know. I mean,
I haven't won a match in two years here,
so that's...
I'm happy.
I'm happy that I did it today.
But, you know, I think massive credit
to the entire Team World.
They pushed us all the way again,
and they were champions last year,
this year.
I think we had a great team.
We had a great team chemistry, team effort,
and we're definitely happy that we won.
How big was it for you?
Was it that your team won the doubles prior
to you going out here?
Did that help your confidence
and free you up a little bit before this match?
Yeah, for sure. We have three chances
to close it out in the singles,
and especially with Carlos playing after me,
I think that gives me a lot of confidence,
gives me a little bit of freedom to play.
But still, it was an incredibly tough match.
Credit to Learner as well.
But I think Carlos is also very happy
that I closed it out.
And me too, by the way.
I'm very happy that I won.
And finally,
you've played this event seven times,
more than any other player in history.
What's your favourite part
of this amazing event here
at the Laver Cup?
Winning as a team.
I think there's no better feeling in sports,
winning as a team.
We don't have enough of it in tennis.
Being among these great players
who I normally see across
the net every single week
and playing alongside of them,
playing alongside two great captains
with Yannick and Tim.
Well, one is very good.
Yannick is the best captain ever,
and Tim has to work on it a little bit.
I think it's just fun being out here.
Awesome. Well, congratulations.
Go celebrate with your team.
